item.title: Gold slides below $4,600 as profit-taking grows, Fed cut doubts rise
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) registers losses of over 0.70% on Friday as traders take profits, as in the last two weeks, data in the US has shown the labor market is not as weaker as expected.

item.title: EUR/USD slips to 1.1600 as firm US data dampens Fed easing hopes
item.description: EUR/USD drops even though the Dollar pared some of its earlier gains on Friday sparked by solid US economic data releases in the week, which has improved the outlook for the labor market. This trimmed the chances for further easing by the Federal Reserve, a tailwind for the Greenback.
